# Shubhanshu Shrimali

> Official site of Shubhanshu Shrimali, an AI-Native Systems & Game Engineer in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India. Shipped production games and apps to 300,000+ users (Top 10 genre on iOS and Android). Builds Eisen Engine, UE5 dedicated-server netcode, LangGraph agents, Hermes + Graphify, and self-hosted vLLM.
